function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Key Points (2024)** | Topic | Summary | Practical Tips | |-------|---------|----------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits: 35–75 mph on highways, 25–45 mph in residential areas.
• “No speed limit” zones exist on some rural roads. | • Always obey posted signs; use a GPS that updates speed limits. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat or booster. | • Check the seat‑belt reminder light; it turns on if a belt isn’t fastened. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held use is illegal while driving.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | • Use voice‑control or a Bluetooth headset. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | • Designate a sober driver or use rideshare services. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the vehicle on the right has priority.
• Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks. | • Always check for pedestrians before proceeding. | | **School Bus** | • Stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Cannot pass the bus until the lights stop flashing. | • Keep a safe distance (at least 20 ft) from the bus. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Use turn signals at least 100 ft before changing lanes.
• Do not pass on the right unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | • Check mirrors and blind spots before moving. | | **Parking** | • No parking on sidewalks, in front of driveways, or in fire lanes.
• Parking meters and municipal lots have time limits. | • Pay meters or use parking apps to avoid tickets. | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Vehicles may be towed for illegal parking or if they pose a hazard.
• The owner is responsible for towing fees. | • Keep your registration and insurance documents handy. | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must register within 30 days of moving to Texas.
• Minimum liability insurance: 30/60/25 (bodily injury per person, bodily injury per accident, property damage). | • Keep proof of insurance in the vehicle at all times. | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Speed cameras are used in many counties. | • Drive within posted limits to avoid fines. | | **Roadside Assistance & Emergency** | • Call 911 for emergencies.
• For non‑emergency roadside assistance, use the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) roadside assistance program. | • Keep a roadside emergency kit (spare tire, jack, warning triangle). | ### Quick Reference Links - **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – [https://www.txdmv.gov](https://www.txdmv.gov) - **Texas Transportation Code** – [https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.HTM](https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.HTM) - **TxDOT Traffic Safety** – [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or regulation!
